recommendations.message: Sleep was under 6.5 hours. An earlier bedtime and fewer screens in the last hour before bed may help tonight.
recommendations.rationale: Short sleep is associated with stronger appetite and less stable glucose the next day.

recommendations.message: Calorie intake is more than 15% above your daily target. For your next meal, a protein and vegetable-heavy option with fewer added fats or refined carbs would bring the day closer to target.
recommendations.rationale: Intake that stays well above a personal target over many days tends to lead to gradual weight gain.

recommendations.message: Sugar is high and fiber is low today. Pairing carbohydrate-rich foods with fiber, protein, or fat tends to soften the glucose rise after a meal.
recommendations.rationale: Fiber slows how quickly sugar is absorbed, so high-sugar, low-fiber meals tend to produce sharper glucose rises.

recommendations.message: Water intake is below 1.5 L today. Keeping a bottle nearby and drinking a glass every hour or so is an easy way to catch up.
recommendations.rationale: Mild dehydration can affect concentration and is sometimes mistaken for hunger.

recommendations.message: Protein intake is below target. A palm-sized serving of chicken, fish, legumes, or Greek yogurt at your next meal would help.
recommendations.rationale: Today's protein intake is under 80% of your personal target.
